question: Linked employer-employee microdata where individual workers can be followed across employers for 10+ years, to run an AKM decomposition of rising wage inequality into within-firm and between-firm parts.

requirements.text: Worker ID and firm ID on each job spell
Enough job movers for a large connected set

record.title: Linked-Employer-Employee-Daten des IAB (LIAB): LIAB- Längsschnittmodell 1975-2024, Version 1

access.evidence: FDZ page: 'On-site Use / Remote Desktop Access including Remote Execution'

record.description: Die Linked-Employer-Employee-Daten des IAB (LIAB) kombinieren die Interviews des IAB-Betriebspanels mit den zugehörigen Betriebs- und Personendaten aus den Prozessen der Bundesagentur für Arbeit. Letztere umfassen einerseits die administrativen Betriebsinformationen aus dem Betriebs-Historik-Panel (BHP) und andererseits die Erwerbsbiographien der in den interviewten Betrieben beschäftigten Personen. Die LIAB Daten ermöglichen somit eine simultane Analyse der Angebots- und Nachfrageseite des Arbeitsmarktes.
record.publisher: Forschungsdatenzentrum (FDZ) der Bundesagentur für Arbeit (BA) im Institut für Arbeitsmarkt- und Berufsforschung (IAB)

notes: the DOI 10.5164/iab.liablm7524.de.en.v1 is registered and resolves to https://fdz.iab.de/en/int_bd_pd/linked-employer-employee-data-of-the-iab-liab-liab-longitudinal-model-1975-2024-version-1/

the landing page mentions "Data Usage Agreement" ("...berg. DOI: 10.5164/IAB.FDZD.2609.en.v1 According to the FDZ Data Usage Agreement, any type of publication resulting from work with FDZ data..."); confirm the access route on that page before calling the data open
access tier unknown (no standard access statement in rightsList); read the landing page before calling the data open
verification.found_title: Linked-Employer-Employee-Daten des IAB (LIAB): LIAB- Längsschnittmodell 1975-2024, Version 1

sentences: Due to size restrictions, the employment biographies of all employees can only be provided for establishments with up to 49 employees subject to social security.

With your application to LIAB, we provide automatically data from the IAB Establishment Panel for all establishments with linkage consent, the administrative individual data, and the Basis Establishment File of the BHP.
Further modules of the BHP have to be requested explicitly in your application.
According to the FDZ Data Usage Agreement, any type of publication resulting from work with FDZ data must be reported to the FDZ by email at the latest one month after publication.

datasets.why: German worker biographies (daily spells, 1975-2024) linked to establishments, with AKM effects for 1985-2023 offered on request by the FDZ.

R1.evidence: Biographies 1975-2024 for workers in IAB Establishment Panel firms

R2.evidence: Employer-linked spells; moves between establishments observed

R3.evidence: Sample is workers of panel establishments (all workers if <50 employees, 20% sample of larger ones), so the connected set is selective

R4.evidence: Daily wages, full population admin source

access_steps: Check eligibility and project rules on the FDZ data access page
Submit a project application and sign the FDZ Data Usage Agreement
Work on-site at the FDZ or a partner site, or by remote desktop with remote execution; outputs are vetted
caveats: Only one base period per project (cannot be combined), which limits the within-project time span unless you use the full 1975-2024 biographies
Whether researchers abroad can use it, and how, was not stated on the page; ask the FDZ (IDAN network)
Publications must be reported to the FDZ within one month

record.title: SIAB Sample of Integrated Labour Market Biographies (IAB FDZ)

access.evidence: FDZ page: SUF can be downloaded by applying institutions after a use agreement; weakly anonymous version on-site/remote only

record.description: The Sample of Integrated Labour Market Biographies (SIAB) is a 2 percent random sample drawn from the Integrated Employment Biographies (IEB) of the Institute for Employment Research (IAB).

notes: description, publisher read from the landing page's own metadata
access tier unknown: no registry metadata states it; read the landing page before calling the data open
verification.found_title: Sample of Integrated Labour Market Biographies (SIAB) - FDZ - Forschungsdatenzentrum

sentences: The IEB consist of all individuals in Germany, which are characterized by at least one of the following employment status: employment subject to social security (in the data since 1975), marginal part-time employment (in the data since 1999), benefit receipt according to the German Social Code III or II (SGB III since 1975, SGB II since 2005), officially re…
The factually anonymous data set can be downloaded by the applying institutions as a Scientific Use File (SUF).

datasets.why: 2% sample of German social-security biographies, 1975-2021ish; the most widely used FDZ file (over 43% of FDZ projects).

R2.evidence: Weakly anonymous version has establishment IDs and is on-site/remote only; the downloadable SUF has none

R3.evidence: Individuals are a sample, so firm connected set is thin

access_steps: Downloadable scientific use file: institution signs a use agreement with the IAB
Weakly anonymous version (has establishment IDs): research visit or remote access via JoSuA
You cannot get both versions in one project
caveats: The SUF cannot be used for AKM because it lacks establishment identifiers (page: no establishment identifiers, so establishment data can't be merged)
A 2% sample gives a small connected set

record.title: MCVL Muestra Continua de Vidas Laborales (Spain Social Security)

access.evidence: Portal de Datos: institutions justifying non-commercial research may request it; DGOSS approves via an online form

notes: publisher read from the landing page's own metadata
access tier unknown: no registry metadata states it; read the landing page before calling the data open

sentences: Para cada persona se incluyen tanto datos sobre su relación con la Seguridad Social en dicho año como datos históricos, en la medida en que se conserven en registros informatizados.
La tabla de Bases de Cotización refleja, mes a mes, el importe de las bases de cotización registradas por las personas seleccionadas en la MCVL a lo largo de su vida laboral.

La tabla de Personas incluye una fila o registro por cada persona física seleccionada para la Muestra, recogiendo en columnas sus características demográficas esenciales que constan en las bases de datos de la Seguridad Social y del Padrón Municipal.

La tabla de Convivientes incluye una fila o registro por cada persona física seleccionada para la MCVL que figure registrada en el Padrón Municipal Continuo, de modo que se pueda identificar la hoja padronal en la que está inscrita.

datasets.why: 4% sample of Spanish Social Security histories with employer account codes, annual waves since 2004, free for researchers.

R1.evidence: Yearly cross-sections with retrospective histories, so long panels (from memory: back to 1980s)

R2.evidence: Affiliation episodes by employer account code (código de cuenta de cotización)

R3.evidence: 4% worker sample; connected sets are workable and many papers use it (from memory)

R4.evidence: Earnings are contribution bases, which are top- and bottom-coded

access_steps: Fill in the request form on the Social Security Data Portal (Portal de Datos), naming the researchers
Your institution must back the request; DGOSS reviews and approves
Receive the files; or apply to use a research room (Madrid, Barcelona, Albacete) or remote access
caveats: Contribution bases are capped, which biases top-end inequality; this matters for rising inequality
Cite DGOSS and send them your outputs
Time to access and the exact number of forms are from secondary sources, not confirmed

not_recommended.name: RAIS public microdata (Brazil)
not_recommended.reason: Open, but de-identified: no worker ID, so workers cannot be followed. The identified RAIS needs a request to the Ministry of Labour and cooperation agreements.

not_recommended.name: SIAB Campus File
not_recommended.reason: Free but for teaching only; no publications; covers a 2005 unemployment-entry cohort to 2008.

not_recommended.name: US QWI / LODES / J2J
not_recommended.reason: Public but aggregated; no individual worker histories.

not_recommended.name: Replication packages (Taiwan, Brazil)
not_recommended.reason: Code and results for AKM-type papers; the underlying microdata are restricted. Useful for code, not data. Pages blocked automated checks.

gaps: No open or free-download worker-by-firm panel with identified firms was found.
Finland (FLEED), Sweden, Norway, Canada (CEEDD), Portugal (Quadros de Pessoal), France and Netherlands were checked by web search only and are not in this list as verified records.
notes: Checked 2026-11-12. Registry search returned mostly noise; access facts come from the agency pages quoted.
